properties.dataset_name: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons
properties.property_scope: freehold registered property; subset of HMLR Index Polygons for all freehold land and property
properties.geometry_semantics: polygon shows position and indicative extent of a registered property
properties.confidence_rationale: Official GOV.UK/HM Land Registry guidance states the dataset contains freehold registered property polygons, each with a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID related to a registered title. No polygon geometry, title number, or parcel match is fabricated.
